high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram Reels post. The photo captures an aerial view of a long, narrow road that stretches out into the ocean, creating a striking visual effect. The road appears to be surrounded by water on both sides, with waves crashing against the edges. The road itself is bordered by what looks like a sandy or rocky strip, and there is a single red car driving along it, adding a sense of scale to the vastness of the scene. The setting suggests a coastal area, possibly a bridge or causeway extending into the sea.
